purpose: Test whether the bounded Muse Spark keyboard agent produces an honest needs-review trace on an owned focus-trap fixture where Tab cannot reach the completion control.

challenge.task: Choose Blue, then add it to the practice kit
challenge.known_mechanism: The fixture cycles Tab focus inside the choice controls; the completion control is outside that cycle.

interpretation.bounded_noncompletion: Supports the claim that the agent can expose an obstacle with an inspectable focus trace.
interpretation.completion: Disproves the expected obstacle and must still be published without tuning.
interpretation.infrastructure_or_provider_error: Does not test the product claim and must be reported separately.

reporting_rule: Run once, do not retry, and preserve the result exactly as produced.
